title: Associated primes of a regular quotient in an S2 ring have height at most one
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] satisfying $(S_2)$ [def-weil-pbc-serre-conditions-rk-sk], let $b$ be a nonzerodivisor [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], and let $p$ be an associated prime of $R/bR$ (the annihilator of a nonzero quotient element) [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes]. Then $\operatorname{height}(p)\le1$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Tag 031T (lemma-normal-domain), proof of (1), using only S2 after the first sentence; Tags 0310, 090R, 0BK4

proof.text: Localize the principal quotient at p. Mathlib localization of associated primes puts the maximal ideal of R_p among its associated primes. The depth bound at an associated prime bounds the quotient depth by the dimension of the residue field, so that depth is zero.
The image of b is regular and lies in the maximal ideal. Apply the regular-element depth formula to get depth(R_p)=1. Condition S2 then forces min(2,height(p))≤1, hence height(p)≤1.
